units.source_text: 我想：这美丽的物体不久将化为灰烬。

en.t: I thought: before long, this beautiful object would turn to ashes.

units.source_text: 于是心象中的金阁和现实中的金阁，便像将透过给绢描摹的画重叠在原画上一样，

en.t: Then the Golden Pavilion in my mind and the Golden Pavilion in reality were like a picture traced through silk being laid over the original,

units.source_text: 它的细部渐渐地相互重叠，

en.t: and its details gradually overlapped one another,

units.source_text: 屋顶叠屋顶、突出池面的漱清殿叠欣清殿。

en.t: roof upon roof, the Soseiden projecting over the pond upon the Kinseiden.

units.source_text: 潮音洞的勾栏叠勾栏、究竟项的花格子窗叠花格子窗，

en.t: the railings of the Choon-do overlapped the railings, and the latticed windows of the Kukyo-cho overlapped the latticed windows,
until everything matched perfectly with everything else.

units.source_text: 金阁已经不是不可动摇的建筑物了。

en.t: The Golden Pavilion was no longer an immovable building.

units.source_text: 可以说，它化成了现象界的虚幻的象征。

en.t: One might say it had turned into an illusory symbol of the phenomenal world.

units.source_text: 这么一想，现实中的金阁的美，就不亚于心象中的金阁的美了。

en.t: Thinking of it this way, the beauty of the Golden Pavilion in reality was no less than the beauty of the Golden Pavilion in my mind.
